description: A 50-state policy-scan data resource released by Ed Trust in partnership with CASEL that compiles publicly available state policies so educators, advocates, and policymakers can compare support for students’ social, emotional, and academic development.
title: Is Your State Prioritizing Social, Emotional, and Academic Development? 50-state scan

description: A structured clinical handover framework used by healthcare professionals and educators to organize the communication of patient information and recommendations.
title: ISBAR (Introduction, Situation, Background, Assessment, Recommendation)

description: ISD-Agent-Bench is a benchmark dataset and evaluation harness created by YoungHoon Jeon et al.
title: ISD-Agent-Bench

description: The ISEE Assessment is a named assessment framework for evaluating education against holistic human-flourishing and well-being goals, developed by the ISEE Assessment initiative.
title: ISEE Assessment

description: iSELF is a professional-development programme developed for primary teachers that combines SRL theory training, lesson-planning support, coached lesson observation, and reflective feedback to promote explicit, integrated SRL instruction.
title: iSELF professional development program

description: A named electronic short-answer formative assessment format developed at Phramongkutklao College of Medicine that combines student self-scoring against expected answers with immediate understanding-level feedback.
title: ISF-VSAQ (electronic immediate self-feedback very short answer question formative exam format)

description: A freely available collection of approximately 50 recorded 90-minute webinars coordinated by the International Society of the Learning Sciences for use in learning-sciences and computer-supported collaborative-learning education.
title: ISLS webinar video collection for learning sciences and CSCL education

description: A five-step instructional-design framework developed by Isman for planning, developing, implementing, evaluating, and organizing learning activities through input, process, output, feedback, and learning stages.
title: Isman Instructional Design Model

description: A study-developed Unreal Engine 5 nonimmersive VR simulation created by Zhang et al.
title: Isolation Ward Layout and Nursing Procedures

description: A research-based, theory-driven item set for assessing seven teaching dimensions and relating them to students' cognitive, affective, and regulative learning functions.
title: ISQ framework

description: iSTART-2 is a game-based intelligent tutoring system developed by researchers to provide high school students with self-explanation training and practice for reading comprehension.
title: iSTART-2

description: An intelligent tutoring system developed by McNamara and colleagues that trains students in reading-comprehension self-explanation strategies through lessons, demonstrations, game-based practice, and automated natural-language feedback.
title: iSTART (Interactive Strategy Training for Active Reading and Thinking)

description: iSTART-ME is a game-based intelligent tutoring system developed by the iSTART research team to teach self-explanation and reading-comprehension strategies through demonstrations, coached practice, games, and motivational features.
title: iSTART-ME

description: A free iOS and Android application developed by informatics engineers and physicians to provide EUNACOM-style internal-medicine clinical vignettes with study-mode feedback and timed exam-training practice for Chilean medical interns.
title: iSTART smartphone application

description: Istation Reading is a digital reading assessment and instructional platform developed and provided by Istation, with professional learning for educators and school leaders to support implementation.
title: Istation Reading
